{{Short description|Indian motorcar-trading platform}} {{Use dmy dates|date=July 2018}} {{Use Indian English|date=July 2018}} {{Infobox company | name = CarTrade | logo = CarTrade Logo.jpg | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{Unbulleted list|{{NSE|CARTRADE}}|{{BSE|543333}}}} | ISIN = INE290S01011 | founded = 2009 | founders = Vinay Sanghi
Rajan Mehra | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]], India | key_people = Vinay Sanghi (Chairman and MD) | industry = [[Automotive industry|Automotive]] | num_employees = 1,400+ | area_served = India | services = Online auto classifieds | revenue = {{nowrap|{{up}} {{INRconvert|555|c}}}} (FY24) | operating_income = {{nowrap|{{up}} {{INRconvert|164|c}}}} (FY24) | net_income = {{nowrap|{{up}} {{INRconvert|82|c}}}} (FY24){{cite web |title=Investor Presentation - Q4 FY24 Quarter ended |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/624f92a2-9279-4017-a503-aca1a063861b.pdf |website=BSE |publisher=CarTrade Tech Limited |access-date=26 June 2024}} | products = {{plainlist| *CarTrade *CarWale *BikeWale *Shriram Automall *Adroit Auto *CarTradeExchange *OLX India}} | subsidiaries = | website = {{url|cartrade.com}} }} '''CarTrade.com''' is an Indian online auto [[classifieds]] platform serving as a marketplace for users interested in buying and selling new and used vehicles.{{citation |last1=Das |first1=Sohini |title=Used-car market rides the technology wave |date=20 January 2014 |url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/used-car-market-rides-the-technology-wave-114012000038_1.html |website=cartrade.com/ |access-date=28 December 2023}} Headquartered in [[Mumbai]], the company also owns other vehicle trading platforms such as CarWale, BikeWale and CarTradeExchange, the omnichannel [[Auto auction|vehicle auction]] company Shriram Automall, the [[vehicle inspection]] company Adroit Auto, and the classifieds portal [[OLX|OLX India]]. ==History== In August 2009, Vinay Sanghi and Rajan Mehra established a used vehicle platform called MotorExchange.in. The company acquired the used car marketplace CarTradeIndia.com in the same month.{{cite news |last1=Gooptu |first1=Biswarup |date=22 October 2010 |title=Motor exchange: Trading in used cars |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/india-emerging/motor-exchange-trading-in-used-cars/articleshow/6792805.cms |access-date=28 December 2023}}{{cite news |last1=Pahwa |first1=Nikhil |date=11 August 2009 |title=B2B Auto Biz MotorExchange Acquires CarTradeIndia |work=MediaNama |url=https://www.medianama.com/2009/08/223-b2b-auto-biz-motorexchange-acquires-cartradeindia/ |access-date=28 December 2023}} The two platforms were rebranded as CarTradeExchange.com and CarTrade.com respectively in 2014.{{cite news |last1=SN |first1=Vikas |title=CarTrade raises Rs 185 cr from Warburg Pincus, Tiger Global & Canaan Partners |url=https://www.medianama.com/2014/10/223-cartrade-rs-185-cr-investment/ |access-date=16 March 2023 |work=MediaNama |date=14 October 2014}} In November 2015, CarTrade acquired CarWale, an online classifieds portal, and its associated websites in an all-cash deal.{{Cite news|title = CarTrade acquires rival CarWale |url = http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tech/tech-news/CarTrade-acquires-rival-CarWale/articleshow/49776146.cms|website = The Times of India| date=14 November 2015 |access-date = 2015-11-24}} In May 2017, CarTrade acquired vehicle inspection and valuation venture Adroit Inspection in an all-cash deal.{{Cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/cartrade-acquires-vehicle-inspection-adroit-inspection/articleshow/58508031.cms|title=CarTrade acquires vehicle inspection Adroit Inspection|date=2017-05-04|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2017-08-11}} In January 2018, CarTrade acquired a 51% stake in Shriram Automall from [[Shriram Group]]. This acquisition made CarTrade India's largest online and physical marketplace for cars.{{cite news |last1=Thakkar |first1=Ketan |title=CarTrade acquires 51 per cent in Shriram Automall to create India's largest online vehicle transaction platform |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/cartrade-acquires-51-per-cent-in-shriram-automall-to-create-indias-largest-online-vehicle-transaction-platform/articleshow/62634517.cms |access-date=2 June 2021 |work=The Economic Times |date=25 January 2018}} In August 2021, CarTrade Tech Limited launched its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) and got listed on [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]].{{cite news |date=August 21, 2021 |title=No IPO magic for CarTrade, loses 7.3% on debut day |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/no-ipo-magic-for-cartrade-loses-7-3-on-first-day/articleshow/85499153.cms |access-date=28 December 2023}} In February 2023, CarTrade set up CarTrade Ventures to acquire and invest in automotive technology companies.{{cite news |title=CarTrade launches CarTrade Ventures, plans to invest Rs 750 crore in automotive space |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/cartrade-launches-cartrade-ventures-plans-to-invest-rs-750-crore-in-automotive-space/articleshow/98185585.cms |access-date=16 March 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=23 February 2023}} In July 2023, CarTrade acquired [[OLX]] India's classifieds and auto sales business for {{INRConvert|537|c}}.{{cite news |title=CarTrade Tech says it owns classifieds platform OLX's entire India business |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/cartrade-tech-says-it-is-acquiring-entire-india-biz-of-classifieds-platform-olx/articleshow/101706594.cms |access-date=26 June 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=13 July 2023}} In October 2023, CarTrade announced the closure of OLX India's auto sales division but continued to operate the OLX classifieds platform.{{cite news |last1=Bhatnagar |first1=Rishabh |title=CarTrade To Shut OLX's Auto Sales Business On Unit Economics Woes |url=https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/cartrade-to-shut-olxs-auto-sales-business-on-unit-economics-woes |access-date=26 June 2024 |work=NDTV Profit |date=25 October 2023 |language=en}} == Services== CarTrade operates as a platform for [[business-to-business]] (B2B) and [[business-to-consumer]] (B2C) operations. The service is divided into two sets – CarTrade.com, the B2C portal where users can buy and sell new and used cars, and CarTradeExchange.com, the B2B dealer portal which allows dealers to manage their online [[auction]]s and sales.{{cite web |last=Das |first=Sohini |date=November 3, 2014 |title=Cartrade.com plans to launch multiple products on mobile platform |url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/cartrade-com-plans-to-launch-multiple-products-on-mobile-platform-114110300001_1.html |access-date=3 November 2014}} Other than the online marketplace, it has a physical presence with a network of over 4,000 dealers across 80 cities in India.{{cn|date=May 2024}} The website currently lists over 1,65,000 certified used cars.{{cite web |title=Cartrade com showcases its wide choice of used cars through its latest |url=http://www.apnnews.com/2015/06/25/cartrade-com-showcases-its-wide-choice-of-used-cars-through-its-latest/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701183801/http://www.apnnews.com/2015/06/25/cartrade-com-showcases-its-wide-choice-of-used-cars-through-its-latest/ |archive-date=2015-07-01 |access-date=25 June 2015}}{{citation |url=http://www.livemint.com/Industry/dJOmS1HNhnByaH98qZtEGI/Preowned-luxury-cars-gain-traction-among-buyers.html|last1=Mohile|first1=Shally|date=28 October 2014| website=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]|access-date=11 May 2016|title=Pre-owned luxury cars gain traction among buyers}} Along with car listings, the portal also offers car price information, certification, insurance, used car finance, comparisons, on-road prices, and reviews. The used car certification program is jointly conducted by CarTrade engineers and sellers who inspect the initial condition of [[cars]] at different levels, and a detailed condition report is presented as part of the online listing. CarTrade also provides similar services for bikes (new and used) on Bikewale portal.{{citation |url=http://www.cartrade.com/company/about-us| website=cartrade.com|access-date=11 May 2016|title=About Us}} ==Promoters== CarTrade.com is promoted by its founder and CEO, Vinay Sanghi, who is the former CEO of [[Mahindra Group|Mahindra]] First Choice. Rajan Mehra, an Ex-[[managing director|MD]] at Nirvana Venture Advisors and former country Head of [[eBay|eBay India]] is also a founder-director in CarTrade. It has received funding from various investors like [[Canaan Partners]], Epiphany Overseas Ventures, [[Tiger Global]], [[Temasek Holdings|Temasek]], March Capital, [[Austin Ligon]], and [[Warburg Pincus]].{{cite web |date=2016-04-11 |title=Singapore's Temasek, March Capital lead Rs 950-crore investment in CarTrade |url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2016-01-13/news/69735476_1_cartrade-vinay-sanghi-used-cars |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160118191925/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2016-01-13/news/69735476_1_cartrade-vinay-sanghi-used-cars |archive-date=2016-01-18 |website=[[The Economic Times]]}}{{cite web|title=CarTrade.com raises $30M from Warburg Pincus, Canaan & Tiger Global|website=VC
